newsitem.title: CANADA: Americans increase travel to Canada over year.
newsitem.headline: Americans increase travel to Canada over year.

text.p: Americans have increased their one-day forays into Canada in the past year while Canadians have cut theirs, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.

Americans made 1.60 million cross-border car trips to Canada in February, 6.7 percent more than a year earlier. The agency cited the opening of a new Canadian casino at Niagara Falls as part of the reason. Canadians made 2.40 million trips, 3.0 percent less.

On a seasonally adjusted basis Canadian same-day car trips to the United States rose 3.3 percent to 3.04 million from 2.95 million in January. American trips on this basis rose 4.2 percent to 2.15 million from 2.07 million in January.
